checklist.detail: joined, headline, social, GDELT, and TweetsKB are frozen; the pooled Arm A SD stays 0.10636804456181562 and is not used as a source SD
k=2, baseline [-28,-1] with 14 days, 5 mentions, 8-day gap, divisor n-1
pre [-7,-1], post [0,7], at least 3 observed days, event-entity documents excluded
mean 0.20, SD ratio [0.5, 2], mention ln2, popularity ln3, balance SMD 0.20
11 bucket names stay on the map; the logged 2026-10-21 union is the match list for those two
H1 and each H2 class need 10 pairs; H4 needs 5 events on each source; SESOI is 0.05
eight tests, bootstrap seed 0, pair permutation seed 1, rewiring seed 2, placebo seed 3; GNN seeds 0-4 are not used
Arm A and Arm B are estimated in separate calls and never concatenated

checklist.item: Tesla is excluded from Arm B

news_joined_restricted.pairs: headline or summary names the node

h3: not estimated; Phase 5 training was not started

choices.pair_permutation: phase4_analysis.pair_permutation, each pair independently, seed 1, 1000 draws
choices.h2_permutation: the same sign flip applied to aligned shifts
choices.h4_permutation: two-sample reassignment of the pair differences or lag values, seed 1, 1000 draws
choices.h1_decision_rejects: unadjusted pair and rewiring p-values below 0.05
choices.rewired_targets: one-hop neighbors on the rewired graph
choices.confirmatory_targets: registered one-hop positive and competitor targets
choices.distance: Mahalanobis on the four covariates among caliper passers; singular or ill-conditioned covariance uses standardized Euclidean
